nom: Hero Cosmetics Pimple Correct Acne Clearing Gel Pen

Works great on breakouts. my skin started clearing up so quickly after using it for a few days. It is a bit drying, but definitely worth it.

Don't ask me why at age 55 I'm still getting acne and why it's on my scalp. All I know is this pen has been amazing at applying the medicine and clearing these pesky little things off my forehead and scalp. No lie, I had one that has been resisting medicine for 6 years (neosporin, aquafor, cortisol, etc.) and this pen cleared it up and it's completely gone. I apply it at night so I don't accidentally rub it off. It absorbs quickly too so it's not on my pillow either. LOVE THIS PRODUCT!!!

I loved the idea of the pen with this product. Unfortunately the pen pump broke within a week and the formula did not help my acne spots like other salicylic acid based products do. Would not recommend. But love this brand and so many other products

Had two monster pimples on my chin. You know the type… brught red and painful. I purchased this because honestly it was the first spot treatment I found when I was walking around the store. Put some on the two pimples before going to bed… next morning the reddness is nearly completely gone, they arent as raised and they dont hurt. They are disappearing before my eyes! So happy I stumbled upon this spot treatment!

I read the reviews, I knew this might happen, but it was the only one that my HSA would cover. Ridiculous. Next time I'll just buy the things that actually work. I'm going to break it open, use it with a qtip, then never buy it again. I also never write reviews.

I personally love this product. It works so well on my skin and I've gone through 3 tubes now even with the price being a little more expensive then other companys who sell similar products. Most of the negative reviews on this product are just about the packaging and I haven't experienced any issues with it so far. I put this on every morning and night before moisturizer and I have experienced significant changes to my skin. When I use it at night, I wake up the next morning and the pimples have disappeared. Morning use also helps as they disappear quickly throughout the day. I definitely recommend this product!!

avis.titre: Love this product!! But a few issues
avis.texte: I absolutely loved this product!! It worked really well with my skin. Ive been a person who has been looking for a whole bunch of different products, and non of them had worked until i tried the serum. Its pretty hydrating and moisturizing and could see results after just one use. The packaging however definitely could be improved because it took is forever on how to open it. Overall, I would highly recommend to anyone who had acne and is great for sensitive skin. ✨

I have never had something work so well on my skin. I had a pimple for literally years, to the point where I was convinced it must be a scar from me messing with it and this reduced in within HOURS. And now it's finally gone!
I have had acne on my forehead for months and nothing was helping. I started using this product four days ago and it is almost completely cleared!! I 100% recommend this is amazing!
Put this on my desk and if I find myself fidgeting with acne I put a layer of it on. Doesn't do much expect keep me from touching face honestly.

I love this pimple pen. Some reviews complain about the pen's pumping mechanism, but I like it. It gives out the right amount of serum so that it can be applied easily in specific areas without wasting or spreading into sensitive areas. For example, I used this product on a pimple with a head and one that had not yet formed a head on the side of my nose near my eyes without getting too close to my actual eyes. I easily applied this serum to ~5 pimples, some with heads and some without, in the evening before also applying a nightly moisturizer. After the first night, the acne without a head was gone without a trace or any irritation/issues. After the second night, the acne with a head was also gone. This allowed the acne to go away without ever getting as big/noticeable as when I had popped them or whatever in the past. I experienced no extra drying/redness/whatever skin issues some products can cause. This really is an excellent, effective product.

I have to rate this 1 star because i could not get the product out of ths pen. I tried dor several days before giving up and throwing it away unused. Looks like I'm not the only one, based on reviews.
It worked every so often but it always left a film that started to peel.

This is the 2nd Hero product that I tried. Sadly the price is outrageous and it didn't help me at all. not even a little bit. Its easy to apply and the set up with the tube is nice. Didn't even touch my acne or pimples at all. My pimple patches worked way better than any of the hero brand products.
Dried out my skin and irritated it to the point where it would burn if i didnt constantly moisturize or lotion. Looks like i fell into poison ivy.

avis.titre: Daily use reduced cystic acne but maybe not solo use.
avis.texte: The good news is I don't have the excessive cystic acne I'm used to constantly fighting with unless a hair follicle grows the wrong way. While that's still pretty frequent, that's still a huge reduction of what I was dealing with. I'm finally waking up to tiny pinhole pimples instead of a hairline of cysts and two or three giant cysts on my chin and nose begging for relief (which usually get the zit sticker treatment). I've had to consistently add this to my routine and really use it. I'm almost through my first entire gel stick and I'm finally noticing a difference. It doesn't stop other skin problems, but we're fighting off some of the pimples and making them easier to deal with. It's less stressful. Given my health problems cause other skin issues, I'm pleased. I was hoping, given the promises, there would be a little more... but maybe by making this a permanent part of the routine, I'll achieve what I wanted. So since it didn't conquer all my problems, I think that's four stars. You might really need to get used to using this in combination with zit stickers for maximum benefit.

Couldnt use product went twice to Ulta to replace as could not get any product out after pumping away forever. Twice. Like waist of gas driving back and forth. Phone ulta and told them and they said just drive back to teturn so 3rd trip i must do. How about REMOVE this useless product off shelf

avis.titre: Easy to use and very effective!
avis.texte: I woke up yesterday with a huge painful nodular pimple deep under the skin in my beard and started looking for a spot treatment to help get rid of it quickly. I ran to the store and got one of these after my research and everyone was right- this pen is so easy to use and is very effective. While my pimple today (the day after) is not totally gone it is much smaller and it even stopped hurting the same day a few hours after the initial application. Plus, I can tell this will last me a while as you only need a little bit each time you use it.

This stuff is amazing, and sensitive skin friendly! I've never had a product get rid of pimples so quickly (even hormonal acne, which is so wild). I love how easy it is to travel with too. Will be buying this for as long as they keep making it lol!
